pairs.registryProposal: Upward lesson for the golden path's 'one classification with one authority' paragraph: it names renderers, log redactors and error scrubbers as consumers of the secret predicate, and warns of a screen weaker than the seal. Here the inverse happens: the screen masks (ExtraFieldRenderers.tsx:133) and a second WRITE path duplicates the value into a plaintext metadata column (schemaConfigs.tsx:68). Every write path that copies a value is a consumer of the classification too, so a value classified secret must not reach any unsealed column.
